impact: Software beats are being sold, matching Workday's reaction; little direct effect on Clement's holdings.
summary: Autodesk's fiscal Q3 EPS of $3.20 beat the $3.07 consensus and revenue of $2.16 billion topped $2.13 billion. It raised full-year EPS guidance to $12.70 to $12.76, above the $12.61 consensus. Shares still fell about 3.6% to 4% after hours.
title: Autodesk beats with $3.20 EPS and raises guide, shares fall about 4%
